items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium real-time 3D game environment prop for CubeCrush, an earthy garden-scale survival arena. Grounded semi-realistic art direction, believable materials and restrained sculpting, NOT cute, NOT cartoon, NOT toy-like. Readable silhouette and broad material features; subdued earth colors; rounded worn edges with smooth normals, no low-poly faceting or pixelation. Practical to model in Three.js from a small set of meshes with a baked normal/roughness texture. Object is a STATIC SOLID obstacle that occupies ONE square tile, footprint at most 0.88 tile wide/deep and height roughly 0.6 tile. Compact solid base; no long protrusions or visual gaps suggesting a traversable path. Three-quarter view from above (camera elevation around 40 degrees), visible front and right face, orthographic-like perspective. Consistent soft neutral-warm upper-left key light and subdued fill, realistic contact darkening confined to the asset. Entire object centered and completely visible with 10% transparent padding on every side, occupies about 78% of canvas. Genuinely transparent background, NO ground plane or scenic terrain patch, NO plinth, NO text, NO UI, NO watermark, NO glow, NO characters, NO eyes, NO collectibles, NO explosion or damage effect. Restrict surface detail to what reads at 96px but retain polished texture at 400px. A weathered cut oak stump. Thick squat trunk with five short buttress roots folded tightly into its base, broad bark ridges, a slightly uneven cut top with understated growth rings and one dark split. Brown-gray dry wood, small restrained olive moss at the base only. Mature tactile timber, not a smiley tree, not a fantasy stump, no mushrooms or leaves. Root ends stay inside the compact square footprint. The solid trunk occupies most of the footprint.
